en:
...I'm right, aren't I?
That's you in there, isn't it, Kaito?
Really? Is it really Kaito?

I must reluctantly agree with Shuichi's
deduction—

Man, Shuichi sure loves his cuh-raaaazy
deductions!
...Huh?
You're...still not gonna admit it?
Admit it? But it's wrong.

But, logically speaking, his deduction
tracks...

If it's really Kaito in there, he
would've admitted it by now...
Was Shuichi's reasoning wrong somehow?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, my detective work was flawless.
It's the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that Kaito
is inside that Exisal.

<CLT=cltMIND>So why is Kaito still
fighting me?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this about Monokuma? Or
is there another aspect to this?

You claim everything is set, and that's it.
You don't have any evidence, do you?

You all think the body was switched when
the hydraulic press stopped for a moment...

...but that's just speculation in the end.
No evidence to back it up.

So if we reverse our reverse way of thinking,
then it's likely I didn't do anything, right?

It's totally possible that the body-switching
never happened, and Kaito is dead.
Not *just* possible, it's the actual truth...

Well...it's true there's no proof that
the bodies were switched...

No, we should trust Shuichi's deduction!
I'm sure everything will be okay!

This emotion I've learned...I believe you call
it "faith." That's what I feel right now.
That's right... We have to believe in Shuichi.

Well, I don't care either way.
But if you guys get it wrong...
...you'll have to deal with <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokuma<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
What will the results of this Voting Time be?

If Monokuma makes a mistake, he won't
be able to execute anyone, right?

Then it will be my victory.
And that will ruin the entire killing game.
<CLT=cltMIND>Ruin...?
<CLT=cltMIND>I see...so that's your objective!

<CLT=cltMIND>You mean to ruin the
killing game itself!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's why Kaito has been
so stubborn all this time...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...what does he mean
by ruin, exactly?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma can do whatever he wants to the
rules. How do you "ruin" something like that?
<CLT=cltMIND>What would be the point...?
C'mon, Monokuma. Start the voting already.

Yeah, yeah, I'm gettin' to it. Sheesh...
Let's proceed with Voting Time, shall we?

Sorry I fell short of your expectations, but
I'm pretty sure I won't make any mistakes.

Cuz I got the Ultimate Detective's
airtight logic on my side.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Now I know.
The whole truth, and why.

<CLT=cltMIND>I believe in my own logic...
And...I believe in Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>From this point on, it's not about logic!
It's about how far I'm willing to go!

<CLT=cltMIND>I believe in you, Kaito.
Not as a detective...but as Shuichi Saihara.

Ah...can I just say something? I'd like to
have <CLT=cltSTRONG>one last conversation<CLT=cltNORMAL> before we vote.
...Hm? One last conversation?
There's...more to talk about?

You see, before we vote...there's
something I have to say.
I just need you all to listen...
